content: Composer docs say platform config only emulates a target and must be paired with check-platform-reqs against the real environment; platform-check defaults to php-only and should not be disabled. Composer validate checks manifest and lock consistency. Composer audit reports vulnerable and abandoned packages, and current Composer policy.advisories can block known-insecure versions during dependency operations. Sources: getcomposer.org/doc/06-config.md and /03-cli.md.
